title: zornia latifolia var. cryptantha
intro: Zornia latifolia var. cryptantha, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the pea family, is a herbaceous legume native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Zornia latifolia var. cryptantha are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
